text:
Ava (Marketing): Hey design — we need a set of modular animated micro-cards for the benchmark webinar landing + social push. Think 3 sizes: hero banner (1200x628), feed card (800x800) and story tile (1080x1920). Include: Lottie, GIF fallback, and a static PNG. Variants: A/B headline, 3 color treatments, and an accessible high-contrast palette. Also need localized copy for EN/DE/FR.
Jorge (Design): Got it. Quick Qs: can you share the final headlines and the three color treatments you want? Any motion constraints (duration, easing)?
Ava (Marketing): Headlines: "Benchmark the inference economics" (A) and "Cut inference costs without latency tradeoffs" (B). Color treatments: Brand purple gradient, neutral-light (for enterprise partners), and a warm accent for socials. Motion: subtle entrance + 400ms settle, no more than 6s loop. Keep motion off for story tile auto-play if user prefers reduced motion.
Maya (Product): Also — each card needs an embedded lead-token so clicks map to the right campaign in our CRM. Format should be a data attribute: data-campaign="bench-q2-<variant>". Can design include a small invisible element for that?
Sam (Frontend): That's fine. Prefer `data-campaign="bench-q2-a|b|c"` and we'll map to utm_campaign on click. For Lottie, we use the lottie-player and lazy-load. GIF only for platforms without Lottie support. Please export with 2 sizes for GIF: web and low bandwidth.
Eli (Analytics): Add these tracking params by default: `utm_source=social`, `utm_medium={channel}`, `utm_campaign=bench-q2-{variant}`. Also add an optional `utm_content` for headline A/B. We'll need a CSV mapping of file names to campaign slug at handoff.
Jorge (Design): Motion notes noted. We'll provide a reduced-motion variant (static PNG) and an accessibility palette with >=4.5:1 contrast. For handoff I'll include a Figma file + Lottie JSONs + GIF/PNG exports + a small README. Example README snippet:
```
Files:
 - hero_lottie_A.json
 - hero_gif_A_1x.gif
 - hero_png_A.png
Attributes:
 - data-campaign -> bench-q2-a
 - utm_campaign -> bench-q2-a
Reduced motion: hero_static_A.png
```
Ava (Marketing): Perfect. Timeline: creative drafts by Tue EOD, final assets by next Friday COB. Also need a short caption pack for socials (EN/DE/FR) — 3 copy variants each.
Jorge (Design): Tuesday drafts workable. One ask: can Product confirm whether the lead-token must be present in the HTML or acceptable as a query param on the CTA link? Implementing as `data-campaign` is easiest for front-end mapping.
Maya (Product): `data-campaign` is preferred. If not available we can accept `?campaign=bench-q2-a` on the CTA link. Either works.
Sam (Frontend): We'll wire `data-campaign` -> `utm_campaign` on click and push to GTM. Also: need max asset widths and safe areas. Jorge, include 24px safe margins in exports.
Jorge (Design): Will do. Also prepping a short animation spec: 400ms fade+translateY(-6px) in, 300ms ease-out for settle, 6s or disabled loop. Will attach CSS snippet.
Jorge (Design): CSS snippet:
```
.card-enter { animation: enter 0.4s cubic-bezier(.22,.9,.28,1); }
@keyframes enter { from { opacity:0; transform: translateY(6px);} to {opacity:1; transform: translateY(0);} }
```
Eli (Analytics): Small ask — can you bake the content variant into the filename (eg hero_lottie_A_en.json) so we can automate ingestion?
Jorge (Design): Yep — naming convention will be `<size>_<format>_<headline>_<lang>_<variant>`. I'll include a manifest.json (one-line CSV-style) listing everything.
DeployBot: Reminder: upload final assets to Marketing S3 bucket `s3://redwood-marketing/bench-q2/` and ping #release-war-room when done.
Ava (Marketing): Thanks everyone — meeting to review drafts Tue 10am. Tag me when uploads are live. :rocket:
Sam (Frontend): Ack, will schedule QA for the moment assets land.
Maya (Product): Friendly reminder — localization team needs source copy by Tue noon to meet translation turnaround.
Jorge (Design): Noted. I'll upload the Figma link + drafts by Tue 4pm at the latest.
Ava (Marketing): Awesome. Thanks :thumbsup:
